name: Persistent Marshstalker
description:
This creature gets +X/+0.

Whenever you attack with a creature, if you have threshold, this creature enters the battlefield.
assumptions: Read cond:threshold on trigger node D as the named keyword mechanic Threshold (seven or more cards in your own graveyard).

Read trigger-type attackersdeclared + thing:creature (node D) as "Whenever you attack with a creature" (one or more attacking creatures triggering it), by analogy with the schema's own attack/enter trigger-type naming.

Read node E (a plain enters/self/bf node reachable only from the attack trigger, given node B already covers the card's normal battlefield entry from being cast) as this same card returning to the battlefield from some other zone -- most plausibly the graveyard -- since a bare re-enters only makes sense if the card wasn't already on the battlefield; the schema gives no explicit zone-of-origin field on D or E to confirm this.
couldNotDerive: The value/basis of the +X/+0 static bonus (node C) -- no scaler node or defining cond: feeds X, so what it counts and how large it gets isn't determinable; left as literal "X."
Whether the attacking-creature trigger (node D) is restricted to a specific creature subtype or is any attacking creature -- thing is the coarse word "creature" with no subtype cond given.

The zone this card enters the battlefield from via node E (assumed graveyard, see Assumptions), whether it enters tapped, whether it enters attacking, and whether any cost must be paid to do so -- none of these are encoded on node D or E.
Supertype and rarity -- the self registry supplies neither.
notes:
Confirms both stated translator fixes worked as intended on this second attempt, plus the two explicitly pre-declared deferred gaps show up exactly as expected, plus one narrower residual gap the task didn't name.

1) Fix (1) confirmed: node D is now trigger-type:attackersdeclared / thing:creature, correctly generalized away from what a prior attempt on this same card read as trigger-type:attack / thing:self ('whenever this creature attacks'). Real trigger is Mode$ AttackersDeclared | ValidAttackers$ Creature.YouCtrl+Rat -- the coarse shape (a general attacking-creature event, not a self-only one) is now right. Residual/narrower gap not covered by the task's named deferrals: the '+Rat' qualifier inside ValidAttackers$ Creature.YouCtrl+Rat still isn't captured as a subtype cond on node D (its flags carry only cond:threshold) -- the real card triggers only on 'you attack with one or more Rats', but the current decomposition models the broader 'you attack with a creature' with no subtype restriction at all. My blind reconstruction correctly left this open in Could-not-derive rather than guessing, but it's worth logging back through REVIEW_PROCESS.md since it wasn't one of the two gaps the task named as already-known/deferred -- the ValidAttackers$ fix only partly closed the original gap.

2) Fix (2) confirmed: node D's cond:threshold now derives correctly from the trigger row's own Threshold$True field (rather than only from a static row's Condition$Threshold, which is what previously caused it to be dropped for trigger rows). Matches the real card's 'Threshold —' clause exactly; no gap here.

3) Static +X/+0 (node C): matches the explicitly pre-declared deferred gap. Real ability is 'gets +1/+0 for each other Rat you control' (SVar:X:Count$Valid Rat.YouCtrl+Other); no scaler node feeds node C's cond:delta=+X/+0, so the reconstruction correctly left X unresolved rather than inventing a value.

4) Graveyard-reanimation return (nodes D->E): matches the second explicitly pre-declared deferred gap. Real ability, once threshold and 'attack with a Rat' are both true, lets you pay {2}{B} to return the card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking (SVar:TrigChangeZone: Cost$ 2 B | Origin$ Graveyard | Destination$ Battlefield | Tapped$ True | Attacking$ True). None of that survives in the packet: node D's from is still '--' (not 'gy'), and node E carries no may/cost/tapped/attacking flags. The reconstruction ('this creature enters the battlefield', with source zone/tapped/attacking/cost all in Could-not-derive) is the most it could faithfully say given what's actually on the nodes.

Net: both fixes named in the task hold up -- the first attempt's main misread ('whenever this creature attacks') is gone, and the Threshold condition is now correctly attached to the trigger row instead of being dropped. What's left unmodeled is exactly the two items the task called out as deliberately deferred, plus one narrower additional gap (the missing Rat-subtype restriction on the attacking creature) that the task didn't name but that the ValidAttackers$ fix didn't fully resolve.
